name: Token Corporation
summary: Token Corporation operates as a construction company in Japan. It is involved in the design, construction, operation, and management of apartment buildings and rental condominiums; and construction of general and commercial lease properties. The company also provides tenant recruitment and property management services for rental apartments, condominiums, and retail outlets; and real estate agency services. In addition, it engages in the hotel, advertising, and information businesses. Token Corporation was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
